title: Victory Boxing
overview:
The best-selling contender is here...

Sluggers, Street Fighters, Glass Jawed - You're Going Down!

JVC's new 4D/full motion Boxing simulator, puts you in the ring with the world's best.

Using state-of-the-art animation and arcade gaming techniques Victory Boxing exploits the full capabilities of 32 bit technology to capture the most realistic fight experience produced.

Special moves, customised characters, weight divisions, one on one, World Championships, sparring - master all this and you will be crowned World Champion.

If you have finesse, strategy, speed, glove splitting aggression, tactical cunning and stamina you may have what it takes to be a Victory Boxer, but you must prove it in the ring.

Are you a Victory Boxer?... Are YOU?
